dialog: You're not getting away with that.
You all need to piss off.
Buncha cocky bastards...
Go die in a fire or something.
Don't expect any mercy from me.
GAHH!\n　I'm so friggin' jealous of people like you!
Getting in my way/ huh? Bad move...
I don't hold grudges/ but my envy lasts a lifetime!
I really hate people like you.
If this doesn't do it/ I'm gonna be pissed!
I'm in a lot of pain right now...\n　How about I take it out on you!
Whatever happens here/ I'm ready for it!
I'm not going down without a fight!
Eat this!
Resistance is futile!
Resistance is futile!
I'll blast you to piece!
Green-eyed monster...!
The grass can ALWAYS be greener...
I'm so jealous...
I'll curse you to death...!
You'll WISH you were dead...!
A monster that devours you/ from the inside out!
Green-eyed monster...!
I see you...
This monster will devour your heart!
This monster lurks in everyone's hearts...
And you're no exception!
O green-eyed monster...
Have your fill!
Let's get started...
My hatred/ my desires/ my envy...
I can never seem to be rid of them...
Except like THIS!
That wasn't enough either...
Time for my daily prayers...
I pray for misery... for your untimely demise...
Cause people like you...
Make me so damn JEALOUS!
Ahh/ still not satisfied...
Time to work off some stress!
Every single damn person around here...
Is just so god damn happy all the time...
You can all just DIE!
You deserved that.
I don't give a damn if it's fair.\n　I'm MAKING this your problem.
I don't hear from her? She's at the bar...
I ask her out? She's busy at the bar...
Who do you love more/ me or beer?!
...You could at least pretend to care.
I'm jealous of your tactics.
Guess they don't plan on letting me attack.
Talk about range... makes me jealous.
Must be nice/ getting to fight like that...
Covering for me/ huh? Show-off...
I'll finish them off.
Don't hog all the limelight!
Get on with it already!
What/ are you too busy to finish the job?
Who the hell do you think you are/\n　making ME protect YOU?!
Get down/ numbskull!
I can't let you do ALL the work.
Let me have a go too!
Hogging all the prey? Makes me jealous...
Don't fight without me!
You'd better not have forgotten I'm here.
Make sure you finish them off!
I'll take point/ you follow up.
Hold back a sec/ we don't want any friendly fire.
Time for some group therapy!
Let's tear this jerk a new one!
I'll put all my feelings into this one...!
I wish I could be as pure-hearted as you/ Kisume...
Don't hog the spotlight/ Kisume!
Leave the rest to me/ Kisume.
Kisume/ get down!
Get your crap together/ Kisume!
I'll corner them for you/ Kisume!
Try to finish them off/ Kisume!
I'm here/ Kisume!
Let's show them how it's done/ Kisume!
If you're having trouble Kisume/ just swap with me!
I've got a bucket full of envy/ with your name on it!
Kisume! Let's take 'em apart!
Let's put some feeling into this one/ Kisume!
Yamame...?!\n　You're not supposed to be that type of girl/ damn it!
Leave the rest to me/ Yamame.
Don't hog the spotlight/ Yamame!
Get your head in the game/ Yamame!
This isn't like you/ Yamame!
I'll corner them for you/ Yamame!
Make sure you finish them off/ Yamame!
Don't hog all the easy prey/ Yamame!
Let me have a go too/ Yamame!
Don't hog the spotlight/ Yamame!
The threads of our envy will choke the life out of you!
Yamame! Let's take 'em apart!
Let's put some feeling into this one/ Yamame!
Yuugi/ you really...\n　Damn it/ now I HAVE to beat you!
Quit hogging the spotlight/ Yuugi.
I think you missed a spot/ Yuugi.
Yuugi/ watch out!
You okay/ Yuugi?
I'll match your pace/ Yuugi!
I'll take point/ Yuugi.
Yuugi...\n　Don't forget that I'm here/ okay?
Don't fight without me/ Yuugi!
I'd prefer if you slowed down and matched pace/ but this'll have to do!
I'm counting on you/ Yuugi.
Yuugi's strength/ and my jealousy!\n　We're a match made in Hell!
Alright Yuugi! Let's get physical on their butts!
Let's put some feeling into this one/ Yuugi!
I wish I could be as pure-hearted as you/ Satori...
Don't hog the spotlight/ Satori!
Leave the rest to me/ Satori.
Satori/ get down!
Try using your third eye to read their moves/ dummy.
I'll corner them for you/ Satori!
Don't hog all the easy prey/ Satori!
Make sure you finish them off/ Satori!
I'm here/ Satori!
Forget about my ugly heart/ go peek at them!
Time for some psychological horror!
Satori! Let's take 'em apart!
Let's put some feeling into this one/ Satori!

Don't hog the spotlight/ Orin!
Leave the rest to me/ Orin.
Orin/ get down!
Get your crap together/ Orin!
I'll corner them for you/ Orin!
Don't hog all the easy prey/ Orin!
Make sure you finish them off/ Orin!
I'm here/ Orin!
Finish 'em off/ Orin!
Let's do this thing/ Orin!
Orin! Let's take 'em apart!
Let's put some feeling into this one/ Orin!

Don't hog the spotlight/ Utsuho!
Leave the rest to me/ Utsuho.

Get your crap together/ Utsuho!
I'll corner them for you/ Utsuho!
Don't hog all the easy prey/ Utsuho!
Make sure you finish them off/ Utsuho!
I'm here/ Orin!
Be careful with that firepower/ Utsuho!
Let's do this thing/ Utsuho!
Utsuho! Let's take 'em apart!
Let's put some feeling into this one/ Utsuho!
I wish I could be as pure-hearted as you/ Koishi...
Don't hog the spotlight/ Koishi!
Leave the rest to me/ Koishi.
Koishi/ get down!
I know it's hard for you/ but please use your eyes!
Get your crap together/ Koishi!
I'll corner them for you/ Koishi!
Don't hog all the easy prey/ Koishi!
You don't gotta force it/ Koishi.
I'm here/ Koishi!
Remember I'm here when you're firing/ Koishi!
Let's do this thing/ Koishi!
Koishi! Let's take 'em apart!
Let's put some feeling into this one/ Koishi!
Can't touch this!
Oh/ were you planning on hitting me?
Just so you know/ I'm still jealous of your accuracy!
What is this? Do you just hate me or something...?
Surprisingly/ I actually DON'T envy you.
Well/ you gave it your best shot.
You're actually a paper tiger/ huh?
Did you seriously think that'd be enough...?
Is picking on me really that fun?!
Excuse me! Why're you so strong?!
God/ you suck!
Strike me down/ and you'll spend the next thousand years wishing you hadn't...
Why am I the one you're aiming at?!
Guess I messed that one up...
Can you NOT get in my way?!
You got some kinda grudge?!
I'll remember that...
If you say you were taking it easy on me/\n　I will friggin murder you!
This one's trouble...
Just you wait til next turn!
Really not holding back/ are you?!
You've done it now!
This is getting annoying...
God/ just knock it off!
Ya missed me/ moron!
Didn't even need graze it.
Underestimated me/ didn't you?
That won't even slow me down.
Were you aiming at someone else/ or what?
Not happening!
Close call...
Look/ I'm not judging you here/ but...\n　you should REALLY just give up.
I'm plenty good at dodging/ see?!
Think you're so good you don't even gotta hit me/ huh?\n　Cocky bastard...
Not even close!
Sorry/ I'm way outta your league!
Think you can overcome my jealousy?!
There!
Eyes up/ slowpoke.
You're still green!
For jealousy's sake/ I spit my last breath at thee...
And so I perish/ alone and forgotten...
Welp/ I've had just about enough of that.\n　I'll see you all back on the boat.
Any more and I might actually be in trouble.\n　I'll hang back and wait for you all to finish up.
I came to help/ but just got shot down like a chump...\n　This bites...
And so I perish/ alone and forgotten...
Welp/ I've had just about enough of that.\n　I'll see you all back on the boat.
Any more and I might actually be in trouble.\n　I'll hang back and wait for you all to finish up.
I can't let those overworlders show me up.
What the hell do you even think you're doing?!
This should've been handled by us Underworlders/\n　but here we are...
She got crazy strong all of a sudden...\n　I'm so jealous!
Conquering the surface...?\n　What are you/ a literal child?!
I can't let those overworlders show me up.
For once/ I really don't envy you.
Quelling that power's not going to be easy...
I can't let those overworlders show me up.
I'm jealous of how simple-minded you are.
I'm worried if I take this too seriously/\n　it'll look like I'm a bully.
Feels like she's the real flexible type...
I'm not afraid of a little thunder!
I'm surprised I didn't spot that high horse of yours from further away.
I'd always heard celestials were calm/ and collected.\n　Guess it takes all sorts/ huh...
You came to the wrong neighborhood!
I guess you just don't care who you hurt/ huh?
I think you know who's waiting for you/ Koishi.
I just hope you two can patch things up after this...
Do yourself a favor/ and give up.
Illusions/ huh...\n　Real nasty bunch we got here!
Can't help but notice they only cloned the big-shots.\n　I am SO jealous right now...
Hey. Sheep.\n　Get the hell out of our way.
Do you seriously think Makura would be happy/\n　seeing you burn yourself out like that?
I envy your spirit/ but...
How do you expect me to fight you like that!?
Your schemes end here!
People like you/ who can blindly follow their dreams/\n　make me SO. DAMN. JEALOUS!
Time for you to wake the hell up!
Your schemes end here!
People like you/ who can blindly follow their dreams/\n　make me SO. DAMN. JEALOUS!
Time for you to wake the hell up!
